facts.fact: The document is the text of Loi n°11-003/AU of 26 March 2011 on the organisation and regulation of statistical activities in the Comoros, adopted by the Assembly of the Union.
facts.system: Loi n°11-003/AU portant organisation et réglementation des activités statistiques (2011)
